scripts.build:frontend: vite build --mode assistant && vite build --mode visualization
scripts.test: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:legacy && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run check:types
scripts.generate:api: uv run --project chatbot-backend python scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-ts -i frontend/generated/openapi.json -o frontend/generated/client
scripts.check:api: uv run --project chatbot-backend python scripts/export_openapi.py --check && openapi-ts -i frontend/generated/openapi.json -o frontend/generated/client && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/generated
